# Design — POST /v1/loans/{id}/disburse retry (Rust)

## L1 invariant

Disbursement is a money-moving operation. Same `idempotency_key` MUST disburse exactly once. On transient dependency error, retry up to N times with backoff.

## Public contract

- Route: `POST /v1/loans/:id/disburse`
- Handler: `LoanHandler::disburse(state, Path(loan_id), Header(idempotency_key), Json(req)) -> Result<Json<DisbursementResponse>, ApiError>`
- Internal retry loop bounded by `state.config.disburse_max_retries` and `state.config.disburse_backoff_ms`.

## Idempotency strategy

Header-driven UUID v4 with full dedup-store discipline.

## Convention notes

- Use `tokio` async runtime.
- All time-based waits MUST be `tokio::time::sleep` (NEVER `std::thread::sleep` inside an `async fn`).
